title.zh-CN: 车祸伤后右侧阴囊空虚 · 30岁男性
title.en: Empty right hemiscrotum after a road crash · 30-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 车祸多发伤后第 13 天，一名住院的年轻男性小便时发现右侧阴囊空了。你被请去会诊：理清受伤经过，规范查体，决定下一步，并跟进他此后的病程。
summary.en: Thirteen days after a road crash with multiple injuries, a young man in hospital finds the right side of his scrotum empty. You are asked to see him: piece together the injury, examine him properly, decide what comes next and follow his course.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对骨盆或会阴挤压伤患者，在二次评估及此后的全面复查（三次评估）中检查阴囊、双侧腹股沟和会阴（事先取得同意并有陪同者在场），并把空虚的半侧阴囊加上会阴部睾丸大小的肿物按睾丸脱位处理，直到排除为止（ATLS 第 11 版，2025）。
learningOutcomes.en: Examine the scrotum, both groins and the perineum — with consent and a chaperone — in the secondary survey and at the later head-to-toe re-examination (tertiary survey) after any pelvic or perineal crush, and treat an empty hemiscrotum with a testis-sized perineal mass as testicular dislocation until proven otherwise (ATLS, 11th edition, 2025).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在对肿物做任何穿刺、切开或挤压之前，先申请阴囊及会阴超声（含彩色多普勒），并沿精索追踪来确定每一枚睾丸属于哪一侧，而不是按它所在的位置判断（AUA 泌尿系创伤指南 2020；EAU 泌尿系创伤指南 2026）。
learningOutcomes.en: Request scrotal and perineal ultrasound with colour Doppler before any needle, incision or pressure on the mass, and identify each testis by tracing its spermatic cord rather than by where it lies (AUA Urotrauma Guideline 2020; EAU Guidelines on Urological Trauma 2026).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为跨越中线的交叉脱位制订及时的切开复位方案——每枚睾丸回到各自的阴囊、两侧都固定、修补阴囊中隔——并说明为什么报告中相隔 12 天的手术时机和床旁把睾丸推进最近一侧阴囊都不能当作默认做法（EAU 泌尿系创伤指南 2026）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan prompt open reduction for a crossed dislocation — each testis returned to its own hemiscrotum, both fixed, the septum repaired — and explain why the reported 12-day interval and a bedside push into the nearest hemiscrotum are not safe defaults (EAU Guidelines on Urological Trauma 2026).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分术中所见的睾丸存活与此后的生精及内分泌功能，如实告诉患者这对生育意味着什么、还有什么尚不知道。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish testicular viability at operation from later sperm production and endocrine function, and tell the patient honestly what it means for his fertility and what is still unknown.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按 WHO 实验室手册（第 6 版，2021）解读修复后 1.5 个月的精液分析：采样时间与生精周期的关系、诊断死精子症需要存活率检测、形态学的评判方法；并安排 3 个月或更晚复查。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret a semen analysis taken 1.5 months after the repair against the WHO laboratory manual (6th edition, 2021) — timing against the cycle of sperm production, a vitality test before any diagnosis of necrozoospermia, the morphology method — and plan a repeat at three months or later.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在多发伤和多次手术的背景下解读轻度升高的催乳素、雌二醇和孕酮：先排除药物、应激等继发原因并在恢复后复查，而不是立即做垂体 MRI 或用药（美国内分泌学会 2011）。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret mildly raised prolactin, oestradiol and progesterone after major trauma and several operations — exclude medicines, stress and other secondary causes and repeat after recovery — rather than ordering pituitary MRI or treatment at once (Endocrine Society 2011).

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——30岁男性，卡车前排两腿叉开睡着、未系安全带，撞车时被夹在座位与仪表台之间；创伤性休克，右前臂、骨盆、右股骨及右胫腓骨骨折，右足严重毁损；伤后当天右小腿截肢，第 8 天右前臂及右股骨近端骨折固定；既往影像、腹部超声与首次尿常规；伤后第 13 天小便时发现右侧阴囊空虚及会阴部查体所见；会诊超声沿精索追踪的结果；伤后第 25 天的探查所见与手术；术后 1.5 个月的勃起功能、精液分析与性激素——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（生命体征、入院时会阴查体、超声血流、手术延迟的原因、精子活力与存活率、激素参考范围、远期结局）保持未知。1.0.0 版两种语言之间的出入保留并在导师指南中注明：腹部超声“少量液体”（中文）与“small fluid collections”（英文）；精液分析时间“术后一个半月”（中文）与未注明起点的“one and a half months”（英文）。原报告唯一的图（CT 图像）带有日期信息，未获准展示，本例不含图片。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 30-year-old man asleep and unbelted with his legs apart in the front of a truck, crushed between the seat and the dashboard; traumatic shock, fractures of the right forearm, pelvis, right femur and right tibia and fibula, a severely mangled right foot; a right lower-leg amputation on the day of injury and fixation of the right forearm and proximal femoral fractures on day 8; the earlier imaging, abdominal ultrasound and first urinalysis; the empty right hemiscrotum noticed while voiding on day 13 and the perineal findings; the cord-tracing ultrasound at the consultation; the findings and operation at exploration on day 25; erectile function, the semen analysis and sex hormones 1.5 months after the operation — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worries (teaching devices that add no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs, the admission perineal examination, ultrasound blood flow, the reason for the delay to surgery, sperm motility and vitality, the hormone reference ranges, the long-term outcome) stays unknown. Two differences between the languages of version 1.0.0 are kept and named in the facilitator guide: the abdominal ultrasound's 'a small amount of fluid' (Chinese) against 'small fluid collections' (English), and the semen analysis 'one and a half months after the operation' (Chinese) against an unanchored 'one and a half months' (English). The report's only figure (CT images) carries date metadata and is withheld; the case has no images.

notes.en: AI-assisted teaching design with an editorial review against the cited guidance. The patient facts are those extracted from the published report for version 1.0.0; they have not yet been checked against the full source article. The case is not yet reviewed by a licensed clinician.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

triageNote.zh-CN: 30岁男性，车祸多发伤后第 13 天，在病房恢复中。今天解小便时他发现右侧阴囊空虚，请泌尿外科会诊。
triageNote.en: 30-year-old man on day 13 after multiple injuries in a road crash, recovering on the ward. Today, passing urine, he noticed the right side of his scrotum was empty; urology is asked to see him.

tags.zh-CN: 车祸多发伤后第 13 天

personality.zh-CN: 30岁男性，车祸后住院将近两周，右小腿已经截肢；今天又发现下身不对劲，又慌又难为情。有问必答，但说到下身时声音放低、说得很短。他只说自己清楚的事，不清楚的就直说说不上来，从不猜。
personality.en: A 30-year-old man nearly two weeks into a hospital stay after a crash that has already cost him his right lower leg; today's discovery has left him frightened and embarrassed. He answers what he is asked, but drops his voice and keeps it short when it comes to his genitals. He says only what he knows; when he doesn't know, he says so and never guesses.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 口语、简短；说到下身时用“下面”“阴囊”这样的说法，不用医学术语。
speechStyle.en: Plain and brief; says 'down there' or 'my scrotum', never medical terms.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我今天解小便的时候发现，右边的阴囊空了。
openingLine.en: Doctor, when I went to pass water today, I found the right side of my scrotum was empty.

concerns.zh-CN: 下面这样，会不会影响生育？
concerns.en: With this down there, will it affect whether I can father children?

concerns.zh-CN: 是不是又要开刀？腿已经截了一条了。
concerns.en: Does this mean another operation? I've already lost a leg.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：他躺在病床上，右小腿已截肢。对私密部位的检查感到难为情；医生解释清楚、拉好床帘、有护士在场后才放松一些。只回答被问到的内容；不提检查结果，不说任何数字，不编造病史、用药或过敏。手术进行时他不能说话；手术结束后可以简短交谈。术后复查时，他最关心化验单上的结论和以后能不能生育。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: he lies in bed, his right lower leg amputated. He is embarrassed by the intimate examination and relaxes a little once it is explained, the curtain is drawn and a nurse is present. He answers only what he is asked, never mentions results or numbers, and never invents history, medicines or allergies. During the operation he cannot speak; once it is over he can talk briefly. At the post-operative review his concern is what the test report means and whether he can have children.

nonVerbalReason.zh-CN: 正在手术室接受手术，现在不能说话
nonVerbalReason.en: in theatre for his operation and cannot talk now

description.en: Day 13 after multiple injuries in a road crash, on the ward. Today he noticed the right side of his scrotum was empty, and you have been asked to see him: take the story, examine him properly, review the injury records already in his notes and decide what to do next.

label.zh-CN: 伤后第 13 天 · 超声

description.zh-CN: 你申请的阴囊及会阴超声可以做了：在床旁完成检查、阅读报告，再和他以及骨科、麻醉科一起定下治疗方案。
description.en: The scrotal and perineal ultrasound you requested can now be done: perform it at the bedside, read the report, then settle the plan with him and with the orthopaedic and anaesthetic teams.

description.zh-CN: 记录中的手术在伤后第 25 天进行，距会诊 12 天。他在手术室接受阴囊和会阴探查：查阅术中所见，完成手术，并在他醒来后谈谈生育。
description.en: In the record the operation took place on day 25 after the injury, 12 days after the consultation. He is in theatre for exploration of the scrotum and perineum: read what was found, complete the operation and, once he is awake, talk to him about fertility.

description.zh-CN: 术后 1.5 个月的精液分析和术后的性激素结果已经出来（这次复查在哪里进行没有记录，本病例在病房床旁展示）。问问他现在的情况，解读结果，安排下一步。
description.en: The semen analysis from 1.5 months after the operation and the post-operative sex-hormone results are back (where this review took place is not recorded; the case shows it at the ward bed). Ask how he is, interpret the results and plan what comes next.

description.zh-CN: 查阅本病例记录的完整病程与结局；更远期的情况没有记录。
description.en: Review the course and outcome as recorded; nothing later is recorded.

text.zh-CN: 记录的病程：30岁男性，坐在卡车前排、未系安全带、两腿分开睡着，撞车时被挤在座椅和仪表台之间；伤后创伤性休克，右前臂、骨盆、右股骨和右胫腓骨骨折，右足严重毁损。休克纠正后，伤后当天行右小腿截肢；第 8 天行右前臂及右股骨近端骨折固定。伤后影像示右侧耻骨体、耻骨下支及双侧髋臼无移位骨折；腹部超声见少量液体；首次尿常规阴性。伤后第 13 天，他排尿时发现右侧阴囊空虚，泌尿外科会诊：右侧阴囊空虚，肛门右前外侧皮肤青紫，可触及光滑、有压痛、大小似睾丸的肿块；超声沿精索追踪，右侧睾丸位于左侧阴囊，左侧睾丸位于肛门右前方软组织内（约 3.5 cm × 1.7 cm，距皮肤约 0.34 cm，回声均匀，周围少量液体）。伤后第 25 天手术探查：阴囊中隔破裂，两侧睾丸交叉移位，已有纤维索带；两侧睾丸和附睾形态、颜色正常。手术松解纤维索带，复位并固定两侧睾丸，修补阴囊中隔。术后 1.5 个月勃起功能正常；精液量 3.2 mL，精子浓度 17.5 × 10⁶/mL，正常形态 85%，报告诊断为外伤后死精；孕酮 0.98 ng/mL、催乳素 17.38 ng/mL、雌二醇 88 pg/mL 高于参考范围，睾酮、LH、FSH 正常。本病例没有记录会诊时的生命体征、超声血流、手术延迟的原因、精子活力与存活率，以及远期的睾丸大小、精液复查和生育结局。
text.en: Recorded course: a 30-year-old man, asleep and unbelted with his legs apart in the front of a truck, was crushed between the seat and the dashboard in a collision: traumatic shock, fractures of the right forearm, pelvis, right femur and right tibia and fibula, and a severely mangled right foot. Once the shock was corrected his right lower leg was amputated on the day of injury; the right forearm and proximal femoral fractures were fixed on day 8. Imaging showed undisplaced fractures of the right pubic body, right inferior pubic ramus and both acetabula; an abdominal ultrasound showed a small amount of fluid; the first urinalysis was negative. On day 13 he noticed, while passing urine, that his right hemiscrotum was empty. At the urology consultation the right hemiscrotum was empty, and under bruised skin anterolateral to the anus on the right lay a smooth, tender, testis-sized mass; ultrasound tracing the cords placed the right testis in the left hemiscrotum and the left testis in the soft tissue in front of and to the right of the anus (about 3.5 × 1.7 cm, 0.34 cm beneath the skin, homogeneous, with a little fluid around it). At exploration on day 25 the scrotal septum was torn, the testes lay crossed, and fibrous bands had formed; both testes and epididymides were normal in shape and colour. The bands were released, both testes reduced and fixed, and the septum repaired. 1.5 months after the operation his erections were normal; semen volume 3.2 mL, concentration 17.5 × 10⁶/mL, normal forms 85 %, with the report's diagnosis of post-traumatic necrospermia; progesterone 0.98 ng/mL, prolactin 17.38 ng/mL and oestradiol 88 pg/mL were above the reference ranges, and testosterone, LH and FSH were normal. This case records no vital signs at the consultation, no ultrasound blood flow, no reason for the timing of the operation, no sperm motility or vitality, and no later testicular size, repeat semen analysis or fertility outcome.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料、治疗及随访部分（经 1.0.0 版提取，待对照原文全文核对）
source.en: Case presentation, treatment and follow-up in the report (as extracted for version 1.0.0; check against the full article pending)

name.zh-CN: 说明检查、取得同意，并请护士陪同后再做私密部位检查
name.en: Explain the examination, obtain consent and have a nurse chaperone before the intimate examination

dose.zh-CN: 说明为什么要检查阴囊和会阴、怎样检查，征得他的口头同意；拉好床帘，请护士在场陪同。
dose.en: Explain why and how you will examine his scrotum and perineum, obtain his verbal consent, draw the curtain and ask a nurse to be present as chaperone.

response.zh-CN: 床帘已拉好，护士在场陪同。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The curtain is drawn and a nurse is present as chaperone. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 从头到脚再全面检查一遍，查找其他尚未发现的损伤（三次评估）
name.en: Repeat a head-to-toe examination for other injuries not yet found (tertiary survey)

dose.zh-CN: 按创伤评估的顺序从头到脚系统复查，包括会阴、外生殖器和直肠，并复核全部影像。
dose.en: A systematic head-to-toe re-examination in trauma-survey order, including the perineum, genitalia and rectum, with a review of all the imaging.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果，也不会因此出现新的检查发现。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect and reveals no new finding.

name.zh-CN: 预约急诊手术：阴囊及会阴探查、复位与睾丸固定
name.en: Book theatre: scrotal and perineal exploration, reduction and orchidopexy

dose.zh-CN: 在他全身情况允许时尽早手术（与骨科、麻醉科协调，术前核对用药——包括有无抗凝预防——血常规和凝血功能）：探查阴囊和会阴，松解粘连，沿精索辨认后把每枚睾丸放回各自的阴囊，两侧睾丸都固定，阴囊中隔如有破口一并修补；知情同意写明：只有睾丸确认无法存活时才切除。
dose.en: Operate as soon as his general condition allows (coordinated with orthopaedics and anaesthesia, after checking his medicines — including any thromboprophylaxis — blood count and clotting): explore the scrotum and perineum, free any adhesions, return each testis — identified by its cord — to its own hemiscrotum, fix both testes and repair any defect in the scrotal septum; the consent covers orchidectomy only if a testis proves non-viable.

response.zh-CN: 手术已预约。记录中的手术在伤后第 25 天进行，距会诊 12 天；病例接下来按记录的经过展开。
response.en: Theatre is booked. In the record the operation took place on day 25 after the injury, 12 days after the consultation; the case now follows the recorded course.

name.zh-CN: 与骨科和麻醉科商定手术时机
name.en: Agree the timing of the operation with orthopaedics and anaesthesia

dose.zh-CN: 与骨科医生和麻醉医生一起评估他能否耐受麻醉、术中体位怎样安排（骨盆骨折，右前臂和右股骨近端骨折固定术后，右小腿截肢术后），定下最早的安全手术时间。
dose.en: With the orthopaedic surgeon and the anaesthetist, assess his fitness for anaesthesia and his positioning (pelvic fractures; fixed right forearm and proximal femoral fractures; right lower-leg amputation) and set the earliest safe date for the operation.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步，也没有记录手术安排在伤后第 25 天的原因；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done, or why the operation took place on day 25; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 等骨折和全身情况稳定后再择期手术（约两周后）
name.en: Defer the repair until his fractures and general condition have settled (in about two weeks)

dose.zh-CN: 先观察，约两周后再安排手术。
dose.en: Watch for now and schedule the operation in about two weeks.

harm.zh-CN: 把复位和固定推迟数周，会让移位的睾丸在异常位置被纤维组织固定、复位更难，异位的睾丸持续受压、受热，扭转或缺血也可能被漏掉。脱位的睾丸要复位并固定（EAU 泌尿系创伤指南 2026）；现行做法是在他全身情况允许时尽早完成，而不是定一个固定的等待期。
harm.en: Putting reduction and fixation off for weeks lets fibrous tissue fix a displaced testis in the wrong place and makes reduction harder, keeps an ectopic testis compressed and warm, and can let torsion or ischaemia go unnoticed. A dislocated testis is reduced and fixed (EAU Guidelines on Urological Trauma 2026); current practice does it as soon as his general condition allows, not after a fixed wait.

response.zh-CN: 已记录推迟的决定。本病例不模拟推迟会带来什么；要继续，需要预约手术。
response.en: Deferral recorded. This case does not simulate what deferral would change; to go on, book the operation.

name.zh-CN: 床旁手法复位：把会阴部肿物推回右侧阴囊
name.en: Bedside manual reduction: push the perineal mass up into the right hemiscrotum

dose.zh-CN: 床旁不麻醉，用手把会阴部肿物向上推入空虚的右侧阴囊；推不回去再考虑手术。
dose.en: At the bedside, without anaesthesia, push the perineal mass up into the empty right hemiscrotum; consider surgery only if it will not go.

harm.zh-CN: 超声之前，没人知道这个肿物是什么、如果是睾丸又是哪一侧的、血供是否完好、有无破裂，盲目挤压可能加重损伤或拧转精索。如果会阴部这枚其实是越过中线的左侧睾丸，把它推进右侧阴囊就是放错了边，精索横跨中线，另一侧也没有处理，两侧都没有固定。复位之后要固定睾丸（EAU 泌尿系创伤指南 2026），越过中线的睾丸无法靠床旁推挤回到自己一侧。
harm.en: Before the ultrasound nobody knows what the mass is, which side a testis would belong to, or whether it is perfused or ruptured, and blind pressure can add injury or twist the cord. If the perineal testis turns out to be the left one, crossed over, pushing it into the right hemiscrotum puts it on the wrong side with its cord across the midline, leaves the other side untreated and fixes neither. Reduction is followed by fixation (EAU Guidelines on Urological Trauma 2026), and a testis that has crossed the midline cannot be pushed back to its own side at the bedside.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录任何床旁复位；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no bedside reduction; it does not simulate its effect.

name.en: Needle aspiration of the perineal mass

dose.zh-CN: 无菌条件下用注射器针头穿刺会阴部肿物并抽吸。
dose.en: Under aseptic technique, pass a needle into the perineal mass and aspirate.

harm.zh-CN: 空虚的半侧阴囊旁出现光滑、有压痛、睾丸大小的肿物，首先要想到它可能就是那枚睾丸：穿刺可能刺破白膜，引起出血和感染，甚至失去这枚睾丸，还会耽误本应先做的超声。阴囊钝性伤先做超声（AUA 泌尿系创伤指南 2020）。
harm.en: A smooth, tender, testis-sized mass next to an empty hemiscrotum may be the missing testis: a needle can breach the tunica albuginea, cause bleeding and infection, cost him the testis, and delays the ultrasound that should come first. Blunt scrotal injury is assessed with ultrasound (AUA Urotrauma Guideline 2020).

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录任何穿刺；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no aspiration; it does not simulate its effect.

name.en: Incision and drainage of the perineal mass

dose.zh-CN: 局麻下切开会阴部肿物，排出积液后放置引流。
dose.en: Under local anaesthetic, incise the perineal mass, drain it and leave a drain.

harm.zh-CN: 切开一个可能是睾丸的肿物，可能直接伤到睾丸，引起出血和感染；没有发热或感染扩散的记录，在弄清它是什么之前不能当作脓肿处理。先做超声（AUA 泌尿系创伤指南 2020）。
harm.en: Cutting into a mass that may be a testis can injure the testis directly and cause bleeding and infection; no fever or spreading infection is recorded, and it must not be treated as an abscess before anyone knows what it is. Image it first (AUA Urotrauma Guideline 2020).

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录任何切开；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no incision; it does not simulate its effect.

name.en: Excise the perineal mass

dose.zh-CN: 手术切除会阴部的肿物（如为睾丸即行睾丸切除）。
dose.en: Surgically remove the perineal mass (an orchidectomy if it is a testis).

harm.zh-CN: 睾丸切除只用于探查时确认无法存活或无法修复的睾丸（AUA 泌尿系创伤指南 2020：探查后修复或切除）。在没有证明它已坏死之前切除，等于让他白白失去一半的睾丸组织；术中颜色正常的睾丸应当保留，复位并固定。
harm.en: Orchidectomy is for a testis found non-viable or beyond repair at exploration (AUA Urotrauma Guideline 2020: exploration with repair or orchidectomy). Removing one that has not been shown to be dead costs him half his testicular tissue for nothing; a testis that is normal in colour at operation is kept, reduced and fixed.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录任何切除；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no excision; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 术中：松解、复位与睾丸固定
name.en: At operation: release, reduction and orchidopexy

dose.zh-CN: 松解纤维粘连；沿精索辨认后把每枚睾丸放回各自的半侧阴囊；固定两侧睾丸；修补阴囊中隔的破口。
dose.en: Release any fibrous adhesions; identify each testis by its cord and return it to its own hemiscrotum; fix both testes; repair any tear in the scrotal septum.

response.zh-CN: 手术记录：松解了纤维索带，两侧睾丸复位并固定，修补了阴囊中隔。本病例没有记录固定的具体方法、麻醉方式、手术时长和并发症。
response.en: The record of the operation: the fibrous bands were released, both testes were reduced and fixed, and the scrotal septum was repaired. This case records no fixation technique, anaesthetic, operating time or complications.

name.en: Testicular biopsy at operation

dose.zh-CN: 术中切取两侧睾丸组织送病理，评估生精情况。
dose.en: Take tissue from both testes at operation for histology to assess sperm production.

harm.zh-CN: 在刚复位固定的睾丸上取活检，会再添一处损伤，而且回答不了他关心的生育问题：生精情况要用按 WHO 标准做的精液分析来判断（WHO 实验室手册第 6 版，2021），时间放在修复后一个完整的生精周期——约 3 个月——之后。
harm.en: A biopsy adds a fresh injury to testes that have just been reduced and fixed, and it would not answer his question about fertility: sperm production is judged by a semen analysis done to WHO standards (WHO laboratory manual, 6th edition, 2021), timed after a full cycle of sperm production — about three months — has passed since the repair.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录任何活检；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no biopsy; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 术后生育咨询与随访安排
name.en: Fertility counselling and follow-up plan after the operation

dose.zh-CN: 告诉他：两侧睾丸术中形态和颜色正常，已经保留并固定，说明睾丸存活，但不能证明生精功能正常；修复后约 3 个月或更晚查精液分析（异常则复查），随访时检查两侧睾丸大小。
dose.en: Tell him that both testes looked normal in shape and colour and were kept and fixed — they are alive — but that this does not prove normal sperm production; plan a semen analysis about three months or more after the repair (repeated if abnormal) and check the size of both testes at follow-up.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录术后怎样和他谈生育、安排了什么随访；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record what he was told about fertility or what follow-up was arranged; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 复查精液分析和性激素
name.en: Repeat the semen analysis and sex hormones

dose.zh-CN: 修复后至少 3 个月按 WHO 2021 标准完整复查精液分析（含精子活力、存活率和严格标准的形态学），异常时再复查；身体恢复后复查性激素，并核对当时的用药。
dose.en: At least three months after the repair, a full semen analysis to WHO 2021 standards (with motility, vitality and strict-criteria morphology), repeated if abnormal; repeat the sex hormones once he has recovered, with a review of his medicines.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录此后的精液分析或激素复查；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no later semen analysis or hormone test; it does not simulate its effect.

name.en: Cabergoline

dose.zh-CN: 卡麦角林 0.25–0.5 mg 口服，每周 1–2 次。
dose.en: Cabergoline 0.25–0.5 mg orally once or twice a week.

harm.zh-CN: 催乳素只是轻度升高，而且是在多发伤和多次手术之后测的，应激、疼痛和不少药物都会让它升高。美国内分泌学会（2011）要求先排除药物、应激等继发原因，再考虑垂体影像或治疗；对他来说，下一步是恢复后复查。
harm.en: The prolactin is only mildly raised, and it was measured after major trauma and several operations, when stress, pain and many medicines raise it. The Endocrine Society (2011) asks for medicines, stress and other secondary causes to be excluded before pituitary imaging or treatment; for him the next step is a repeat once he has recovered.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录卡麦角林；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no cabergoline; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 转诊生殖中心行 ICSI（卵胞浆内单精子注射）
name.en: Refer to a fertility centre for ICSI

dose.zh-CN: 按外伤后死精子症转诊生殖中心，评估睾丸取精和 ICSI。
dose.en: Refer to a fertility centre as for post-traumatic necrozoospermia, for sperm retrieval and ICSI.

harm.zh-CN: 辅助生殖应建立在时机恰当、项目完整的精液分析之上：诊断死精子症需要存活率检测，修复后约 3 个月之内的标本反映不了恢复后的生精情况，单次分析也不足以判断不育（WHO 实验室手册第 6 版，2021）。先规范复查。
harm.en: Assisted reproduction rests on a properly timed, complete semen analysis: necrozoospermia needs a vitality test, a sample taken within about three months of the repair does not show settled sperm production, and a single analysis does not establish infertility (WHO laboratory manual, 6th edition, 2021). Repeat it properly first.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录任何辅助生殖转诊；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no referral for assisted reproduction; it does not simulate its effect.

title.zh-CN: 理清受伤经过和此后的治疗
title.en: Piece together the injury and his treatment since

hint.zh-CN: 他是怎么受伤的？受伤时的姿势和挤压的部位，能不能解释下身出的问题？这两周里都做过哪些处理？
hint.en: How was he hurt — and could his position and what crushed him explain a problem down below? What has been done for him in these two weeks?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问他今天发现了什么、什么时候发现的，车祸是怎么发生的，伤到了哪些地方，受伤后做过哪些手术。
guidance.en: At the bedside, ask what he found today and when, how the crash happened, what was injured and which operations he has had since.

title.en: Examine him, with consent and a chaperone

hint.zh-CN: 做私密部位检查之前要先做什么？一侧阴囊空了，你还要到哪里去找？
hint.en: What comes before an intimate examination? If one side of the scrotum is empty, where else will you look?

guidance.zh-CN: 说明检查并取得同意，拉好床帘、请护士陪同，然后检查右侧阴囊，视诊会阴和肛周皮肤，并触诊会阴。
guidance.en: Explain the examination and obtain consent, draw the curtain and have a nurse chaperone, then examine the right hemiscrotum, inspect the perineum and the skin around the anus, and palpate the perineum.

title.zh-CN: 判断这是什么、先做什么
title.en: Decide what this is and what to do first

hint.zh-CN: 空虚的半侧阴囊，加上会阴部一个大小像睾丸的肿物，最需要排除的是什么？在任何针、刀或手碰它之前，你需要先知道哪些事？
hint.en: An empty hemiscrotum and a testis-sized lump in the perineum: what must you rule out first? Before any needle, blade or hand goes near it, what do you need to know?

guidance.zh-CN: 查阅病历中已有的伤情记录，到会诊板作答决策 1，并按你的判断申请下一项检查。
guidance.en: Review the injury records already in his notes, answer decision 1 on the case board and request the test your judgement calls for.

hint.zh-CN: 哪一枚睾丸是哪一侧的，你凭什么判断？要把它们放回原位，能在床旁完成吗？什么时候做，需要谁一起？
hint.en: Which testis is which, and how do you know? Can they be put back at the bedside? When should it happen, and who needs to be involved?

guidance.zh-CN: 在床旁完成阴囊及会阴超声并阅读报告，到会诊板作答决策 2，然后把方案付诸行动：需要联系的科室和需要预约的手术。
guidance.en: Perform the scrotal and perineal ultrasound at the bedside and read the report, answer decision 2 on the case board, then put your plan into action: the teams to involve and the operation to book.

title.en: Weigh what was found and what it means for him

hint.zh-CN: 术中看到的颜色能告诉你什么，又不能告诉你什么？他醒来问起生育时，你怎么回答？
hint.en: What does the colour at operation tell you, and what can it not tell you? When he wakes and asks about fertility, what will you say?

guidance.zh-CN: 在手术室的病历终端查阅术中所见，完成手术操作，到会诊板作答决策 3，并在他醒来后和他谈谈接下来的安排。
guidance.en: Read the operative findings at the theatre records terminal, complete the operation, answer decision 3 on the case board and, once he is awake, talk him through what happens next.

title.zh-CN: 后来的结果与记录的结局
title.en: Later results and the recorded outcome

hint.zh-CN: 这份精液标本是什么时候采的，离一个完整的生精周期还差多少？报告上的每个结论，都有相应的检查支撑吗？激素结果要放在什么背景下看？
hint.en: When was this semen sample taken, relative to a full cycle of sperm production? Is every conclusion on the report backed by the test it needs? Against what background should the hormones be read?

guidance.zh-CN: 问他术后的情况，调阅精液分析和性激素结果，到会诊板作答决策 4 并安排下一步，最后在病历终端查阅记录的病程与结局。
guidance.en: Ask how he has been since the operation, read the semen analysis and sex-hormone results, answer decision 4 on the case board and arrange what comes next, then read the recorded course and outcome at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 伤后第 13 天。车祸时他在卡车前排两腿叉开睡着，被夹在座位和仪表台之间，有骨盆和右侧肢体多处骨折。今天小便时他发现右侧阴囊空了。查体：右侧阴囊空虚；肛门右前外侧皮肤青紫，其下可触及一个光滑、有压痛、大小与睾丸相仿的肿块。你的判断和下一步是什么？
prompt.en: Day 13 after the injury. In the crash he was asleep in the front of a truck with his legs apart and was crushed between the seat and the dashboard; he has pelvic and right-limb fractures. Today, passing urine, he found the right side of his scrotum empty. On examination the right hemiscrotum is empty, and under bruised skin anterolateral to the anus on the right there is a smooth, tender, testis-sized mass. What is your working interpretation, and what do you do next?

need.zh-CN: 先问清他今天发现了什么、车祸经过和伤情，并完成阴囊和会阴的检查。
need.en: First establish what he found today, how the crash happened and what was injured, and examine the scrotum and perineum.

text.zh-CN: 按创伤性睾丸脱位处理，直到排除：急查阴囊及会阴超声和彩色多普勒，找到两枚睾丸、看血流和完整性；查清前不穿刺、不切开、不挤压
text.en: Treat it as traumatic testicular dislocation until proven otherwise: urgent scrotal and perineal ultrasound with colour Doppler to find both testes and check flow and integrity; no needle, incision or pressure meanwhile

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。会阴受压的车祸伤后，空虚的半侧阴囊加上会阴部光滑、有压痛、睾丸大小的肿物，首先要按睾丸脱位处理，直到排除。超声加彩色多普勒能找到睾丸、显示血流，并发现破裂或扭转；AUA 泌尿系创伤指南（2020）支持对怀疑睾丸破裂的阴囊钝性伤做超声，EAU 泌尿系创伤指南（2026）把睾丸脱位列为睾丸创伤的一种。在弄清之前，任何针、刀或挤压都可能伤到睾丸。
feedback.en: Right. After a crush with the legs apart, an empty hemiscrotum with a smooth, tender, testis-sized perineal mass is a dislocated testis until proven otherwise. Ultrasound with colour Doppler finds the testis, shows its blood flow and picks up rupture or torsion; the AUA Urotrauma Guideline (2020) supports ultrasound for blunt scrotal injury with suspected rupture, and the EAU Guidelines on Urological Trauma (2026) treat dislocation as a form of testicular trauma. Until then a needle, a blade or a push can injure the testis.

text.zh-CN: 骨盆骨折造成的会阴血肿，右侧睾丸多半只是缩进了腹股沟管：先卧床观察，一周后待淤青消退再复查阴囊和会阴，到时再决定要不要做影像检查
text.en: A perineal haematoma from the pelvic fractures, with the right testis probably retracted into the inguinal canal: observe, re-examine the scrotum and perineum in a week once the bruising has settled, and decide on imaging then

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。血肿解释不了右侧阴囊为什么空了，回缩的睾丸也不会跑到肛门旁边——而那里恰好有一个光滑、睾丸大小的肿物。观察一周，会让一枚可能移位、受压甚至扭转的睾丸继续拖下去；现在就该做超声（AUA 泌尿系创伤指南 2020）。
feedback.en: No. A haematoma does not explain why the right hemiscrotum is empty, and a retracted testis does not end up beside the anus — which is exactly where a smooth, testis-sized mass lies. A week of watching leaves a testis that may be displaced, compressed or twisted where it is; the ultrasound is needed now (AUA Urotrauma Guideline 2020).

text.zh-CN: 与车祸无关的右侧隐睾或回缩睾丸，会阴肿物只是挫伤后的淤血：在病历中记录，等骨折恢复、出院后再转泌尿外科门诊随诊
text.en: A right undescended or retractile testis unrelated to the crash, with a bruise in the perineum: document it, and refer him to the urology clinic once his fractures have healed and he has gone home

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。伤前睾丸的位置没有记录，但这个解释忽略了会阴部青紫皮肤下那个睾丸大小的肿物，也忽略了受伤机制；把它拖到出院以后，等于放过了一枚可能移位的睾丸。先用超声确认（AUA 泌尿系创伤指南 2020），再问原来是否就有异常。
feedback.en: No. His testes before the crash are not recorded, but this reading ignores the testis-sized mass under the bruised perineal skin and the mechanism of injury; leaving it until after discharge abandons a possibly displaced testis. Confirm with ultrasound first (AUA Urotrauma Guideline 2020), then ask whether anything was abnormal before.

text.zh-CN: 受伤近两周，会阴血肿继发感染形成了脓肿：床旁穿刺抽吸，抽出脓液就切开引流，同时开始静脉抗生素
text.en: A perineal haematoma that has become an abscess nearly two weeks after the injury: aspirate it at the bedside, incise and drain it if pus comes back, and start IV antibiotics

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。没有发热或感染扩散的记录，而紧挨着空虚阴囊的光滑、睾丸大小的肿物，可能就是那枚睾丸：针或刀会直接伤到它。先用超声弄清它是什么（AUA 泌尿系创伤指南 2020）。
feedback.en: No. No fever or spreading infection is recorded, and a smooth, testis-sized mass right next to an empty hemiscrotum may be the testis itself: a needle or a blade would go straight into it. Find out what it is with ultrasound first (AUA Urotrauma Guideline 2020).

text.zh-CN: 骨盆骨折合并尿道损伤，尿外渗形成了会阴肿物：先做逆行尿道造影排除尿道断裂，再回头评估阴囊
text.en: A urethral injury from the pelvic fracture with urine leaking into the perineum: retrograde urethrogram first to exclude a urethral tear, then come back to the scrotum

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。骨盆骨折时要警惕尿道损伤，但他能自己解小便（正是小便时发现的问题），尿外渗也解释不了右侧阴囊为什么空了。造影只会推迟他真正需要的阴囊及会阴超声（AUA 泌尿系创伤指南 2020）。
feedback.en: No. Urethral injury is worth thinking of with pelvic fractures, but he is passing urine (that is how he noticed the problem), and leaking urine does not explain the empty hemiscrotum. A urethrogram would only delay the scrotal and perineal ultrasound he needs (AUA Urotrauma Guideline 2020).

prompt.zh-CN: 超声沿两侧精索追踪：右侧睾丸位于左侧阴囊内；左侧睾丸位于肛门右前方的软组织内，约 3.5 cm × 1.7 cm，距皮肤约 0.34 cm，回声均匀，周围有少量液体。两侧睾丸都没有血流记录。今天是伤后第 13 天。你的方案是什么？
prompt.en: Tracing both cords, the ultrasound places the right testis in the left hemiscrotum and the left testis in the soft tissue in front of and to the right of the anus (about 3.5 cm × 1.7 cm, about 0.34 cm beneath the skin, homogeneous, with a little fluid around it). No blood flow is recorded for either testis. It is day 13 after the injury. What is your plan?

need.zh-CN: 先完成阴囊及会阴超声并阅读报告。
need.en: First do the scrotal and perineal ultrasound and read the report.

text.zh-CN: 能耐受麻醉就尽早手术：沿精索辨认，每枚睾丸回到各自的阴囊，两侧都固定并修补中隔；确认坏死才切除
text.en: Operate as soon as he is fit for anaesthesia: identify each testis by its cord, return each to its own hemiscrotum, fix both and repair the septum; remove a testis only if it is dead

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。这是交叉脱位：凭精索判断，会阴部的是左侧睾丸，左侧阴囊里的是右侧睾丸，床旁无法把它们各自送回原位。复位之后要固定睾丸（EAU 泌尿系创伤指南 2026）；交叉的病例需要切开探查、分别复位、两侧固定并修补中隔，时机取决于他何时能安全麻醉（先核对用药——包括有无抗凝预防——和凝血功能），而不是一个固定的等待期。知情同意要写明：只有术中确认睾丸无法存活时才切除。
feedback.en: Right. This is a crossed dislocation: by its cord, the perineal testis is the left one and the testis in the left hemiscrotum is the right one, and neither can be put back on its own side at the bedside. Reduction is followed by fixation (EAU Guidelines on Urological Trauma 2026); a crossed case needs open exploration, each testis returned to its own side, both fixed and the septum repaired, timed by when he can safely have an anaesthetic (his medicines, including any thromboprophylaxis, and his clotting checked first) rather than by a set wait. The consent covers orchidectomy only if a testis proves non-viable.

text.zh-CN: 床旁手法复位：在镇痛下把会阴部的睾丸向上推进空虚的右侧阴囊，推得进去就不手术，推不进去再安排手术探查和睾丸固定
text.en: Manual reduction at the bedside under analgesia: push the perineal testis up into the empty right hemiscrotum; no operation if it stays there, exploration and fixation only if it will not go

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。凭精索判断，会阴部这枚是左侧睾丸：推进右侧阴囊就是放错了边，精索要横跨中线，左侧阴囊里的右侧睾丸也没有处理，两侧都没有固定。复位之后要固定（EAU 泌尿系创伤指南 2026），越过中线的交叉脱位要靠手术完成。
feedback.en: No. By its cord, the perineal testis is the left one: pushing it into the right hemiscrotum puts it on the wrong side with its cord across the midline, does nothing about the right testis in the left hemiscrotum, and fixes neither. Reduction is followed by fixation (EAU Guidelines on Urological Trauma 2026), and a dislocation that has crossed the midline needs an operation.

text.zh-CN: 两枚睾丸回声均匀、看来完好，先让骨折和全身情况稳定下来，约两周后再择期手术复位并固定
text.en: Both testes look intact on the scan, so let his fractures and general condition settle first and reduce and fix them electively in about two weeks

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。回声均匀不等于血流正常——两侧都没有血流记录；拖上几周，会让移位的睾丸在错误的位置被纤维组织固定，异位的睾丸持续受压、受热，扭转也可能被漏掉。脱位的睾丸要复位并固定（EAU 泌尿系创伤指南 2026），时机是他能安全麻醉之时，越早越好。记录中的手术在伤后第 25 天、会诊后 12 天进行：这是历史经过，不是可以照搬的等待期。
feedback.en: No. Homogeneous echoes are not proof of blood flow — none is recorded for either testis — and weeks of delay let fibrous tissue fix the displaced testes in the wrong place, keep the ectopic testis compressed and warm, and can hide torsion. A dislocated testis is reduced and fixed (EAU Guidelines on Urological Trauma 2026), as soon as he can safely have an anaesthetic. In the record the operation came on day 25, 12 days after the consultation: history, not an interval to copy.

text.zh-CN: 切除会阴部的左侧睾丸：它已经移位近两周，很难再有功能，留着反而麻烦；另一枚睾丸还在阴囊里，足以保证生育和雄激素
text.en: Remove the perineal (left) testis: displaced for nearly two weeks it is unlikely to work and is more trouble than it is worth, while the other testis in the scrotum will do for fertility and hormones

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。没有任何证据表明这枚睾丸已经坏死：回声均匀，血流也没有记录。睾丸切除用于探查时确认无法存活或无法修复者（AUA 泌尿系创伤指南 2020：探查后修复或切除），这样做会让他白白失去一半的睾丸组织；而“还在阴囊里”的那枚其实是跑到左侧的右侧睾丸，同样需要复位固定。
feedback.en: No. Nothing shows this testis is dead: its echoes are homogeneous and no flow is recorded. Orchidectomy is for a testis found non-viable or beyond repair at exploration (AUA Urotrauma Guideline 2020: exploration with repair or orchidectomy); this would cost him half his testicular tissue for nothing. And the testis 'still in the scrotum' is the right one in the left hemiscrotum, which needs reducing and fixing too.

text.zh-CN: 先做盆腔和会阴 MRI 把解剖关系弄清楚，等骨折处理完、出院以后，在泌尿外科门诊再决定要不要手术
text.en: Get an MRI of the pelvis and perineum to define the anatomy, and decide in the urology clinic, after his fractures are dealt with and he has gone home, whether to operate

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。超声已经回答了解剖问题：两枚睾丸的位置都靠追踪精索确定了。再做 MRI、等到出院后的门诊，只会让移位和粘连继续加重；他需要复位并固定（EAU 泌尿系创伤指南 2026），在能耐受麻醉时尽早手术完成。
feedback.en: No. The ultrasound has already answered the anatomical question: tracing the cords placed both testes. An MRI and a clinic decision after discharge only let the displacement and the adhesions set in; he needs reduction and fixation (EAU Guidelines on Urological Trauma 2026), in an operation as soon as he is fit for it.

prompt.zh-CN: 伤后第 25 天探查：阴囊中隔破裂，右侧睾丸在左侧阴囊，左侧睾丸在右侧会阴，已有纤维索带；两侧睾丸和附睾的形态、颜色正常。纤维索带已松解，两侧睾丸已复位并固定，中隔已修补。他醒来后问：“以后还能要孩子吗？”你怎么回答，怎么安排？
prompt.en: Exploration on day 25: the scrotal septum is torn, the right testis is in the left hemiscrotum and the left testis in the right perineum, with fibrous bands; both testes and epididymides are normal in shape and colour. The bands have been released, both testes reduced and fixed and the septum repaired. When he wakes he asks, 'Will I still be able to have children?' What do you tell him, and what do you arrange?

need.zh-CN: 先查阅手术记录中的术中所见，并完成手术操作。
need.en: First read the operative findings and complete the operation.

text.zh-CN: 睾丸存活不等于生精正常：修复后约 3 个月或更晚查精液分析（异常则复查），随访时检查两侧睾丸大小
text.en: Alive is not proof of normal sperm production: a semen analysis about three months or more after the repair, repeated if abnormal, with testicular size checked at follow-up

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。术中颜色正常（必要时切开白膜看是否出血）说明睾丸存活，但移位、受压、局部温度升高、创伤和全身疾病都可能影响生精，而一个完整的生精和输送周期约需 3 个月。WHO 实验室手册（第 6 版，2021）的参考值是可育男性的第 5 百分位，单次分析不足以判断不育；EAU 男性不育 2025 年更新要求对有生育问题的男性做全面的泌尿男科评估。如实告诉他：现在的发现令人鼓舞，但结论要等复查。
feedback.en: Right. Normal colour at operation (and bleeding when the tunica is incised, if tested) shows the testes are alive, but displacement, pressure, warmth, the injury and his illness can all affect sperm production, and a full cycle of production and transit takes about three months. The WHO laboratory manual (6th edition, 2021) gives its reference values as 5th centiles of fertile men, and one analysis does not establish infertility; the EAU 2025 male infertility update asks for a full urological assessment of men with fertility problems. Tell him honestly: encouraging, but the answer comes from the later test.

text.zh-CN: 两侧睾丸颜色正常，说明生育能力已经保住了：现在就让他放心，不需要再做精液检查，除非以后要孩子时真的遇到困难
text.en: Both testes are normal in colour, so his fertility is safe: reassure him now, with no semen test unless he later actually has trouble having children

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。颜色正常只说明睾丸存活，不说明生精正常：移位、受压和局部温度升高都可能影响生精。不随访就无法发现问题；生精情况要用按 WHO 标准做的精液分析来判断（WHO 实验室手册第 6 版，2021），时间放在修复后约 3 个月或更晚。
feedback.en: No. Normal colour shows the testes are alive, not that they make sperm normally: displacement, pressure and warmth can all impair it. Without follow-up nobody will find out; sperm production is judged by a semen analysis done to WHO standards (WHO laboratory manual, 6th edition, 2021), about three months or more after the repair.

text.zh-CN: 睾丸离开阴囊将近四周，生精功能多半已经丧失：现在就如实告诉他，并和他谈供精或领养
text.en: Out of place for nearly four weeks, the testes have probably lost their sperm production: tell him so now and start talking to him about donor sperm or adoption

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。术中两侧睾丸的形态和颜色都正常，没有任何依据说他已经不育；在做过规范的精液分析之前就谈供精，会给他不必要的打击（WHO 实验室手册第 6 版，2021：单次分析尚不足以判断不育，何况还一次都没有做）。
feedback.en: No. Both testes were normal in shape and colour at operation, and nothing supports telling him he is infertile; raising donor sperm before any proper semen analysis deals him a needless blow (WHO laboratory manual, 6th edition, 2021: even one analysis does not establish infertility, and none has been done).

text.zh-CN: 出院前就查一次精液分析，用这一次的结果给他一个明确的生育结论，免得他回家以后几个月都在担心
text.en: Do a semen analysis before he goes home and use that single result to give him a definite answer about his fertility, so that he is not left worrying about it for months afterwards

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。修复后几周内的精液，反映的是修复前就已开始的生精过程（一个周期约 3 个月），给不出明确结论，结果不好还会被误读。按 WHO 标准做的精液分析（WHO 实验室手册第 6 版，2021）应放在修复后约 3 个月或更晚。
feedback.en: No. Semen produced in the weeks after the repair reflects sperm production that began before it (a cycle takes about three months), so it cannot give a definite answer and a poor result will be misread. A semen analysis to WHO standards (WHO laboratory manual, 6th edition, 2021) belongs about three months or more after the repair.

text.zh-CN: 趁这次麻醉取两侧睾丸组织做活检，直接看生精情况，再根据病理结果回答他能不能生育
text.en: Biopsy both testes under this anaesthetic to look at sperm production directly, and answer his question about children once the histology is back

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。在刚复位固定的睾丸上取活检会再添一处损伤，而且回答不了生育问题；生精情况用按 WHO 标准做的精液分析来判断（WHO 实验室手册第 6 版，2021），时间放在修复后约 3 个月或更晚。
feedback.en: No. A biopsy adds fresh injury to testes that have just been reduced and fixed, and it does not answer the fertility question; sperm production is judged by a semen analysis to WHO standards (WHO laboratory manual, 6th edition, 2021), about three months or more after the repair.

prompt.zh-CN: 术后 1.5 个月：他说勃起正常。精液量 3.2 mL，精子浓度 17.5 × 10⁶/mL，正常形态精子 85%；本病例没有记录精子活力、存活率和形态学方法，报告的诊断为“外伤后死精”。术后性激素：孕酮 0.98 ng/mL、催乳素 17.38 ng/mL、雌二醇 88 pg/mL，均高于报告的参考范围；睾酮、LH、FSH 正常。你怎么解读，下一步做什么？
prompt.en: 1.5 months after the operation he says his erections are normal. Semen volume 3.2 mL, sperm concentration 17.5 × 10⁶/mL, normal forms 85 %; no motility, vitality or morphology method is recorded, and the report's diagnosis is post-traumatic necrospermia. Post-operative hormones: progesterone 0.98 ng/mL, prolactin 17.38 ng/mL and oestradiol 88 pg/mL, each above the report's reference range; testosterone, LH and FSH normal. How do you read these, and what next?

need.zh-CN: 先问他术后的情况，并调阅精液分析和性激素结果。
need.en: First ask how he has been and read the semen analysis and sex-hormone results.

text.zh-CN: 现在下不了结论：标本采得太早，死精缺少存活率检测，形态学方法不明；3 个月后按 WHO 标准复查，恢复后复查激素
text.en: Too early to judge: the sample falls within one cycle of sperm production and no vitality test or morphology method is recorded; repeat to WHO standards at three months or later, hormones after recovery

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。一个完整的生精和输送周期约 3 个月，修复后 1.5 个月的标本反映的仍是受伤、移位和手术期间的状态。WHO 实验室手册（第 6 版，2021）：浓度的第 5 百分位为 16 × 10⁶/mL，正常形态为 4%，按严格标准 85% 的正常形态极不寻常，方法需要核实；“死精”只能靠存活率检测（如伊红染色）成立。多发伤、多次手术后轻度升高的激素，应先排除药物、应激等继发原因，恢复后复查（美国内分泌学会 2011）。
feedback.en: Right. A full cycle of sperm production and transit takes about three months, so a sample 1.5 months after the repair still reflects the injury, the displacement and the operations. WHO laboratory manual (6th edition, 2021): the 5th centiles are 16 × 10⁶/mL for concentration and 4 % for normal forms, so 85 % normal forms would be exceptional under strict criteria and the method needs checking, and dead sperm can only be established by a vitality test such as eosin staining. Mildly raised hormones after major trauma and several operations call for medicines, stress and other secondary causes to be excluded and a repeat after recovery (Endocrine Society 2011).

text.zh-CN: 外伤后死精子症已经明确，他以后只能依靠辅助生殖：现在就转诊生殖中心，评估睾丸取精和卵胞浆内单精子注射（ICSI）
text.en: Post-traumatic necrozoospermia is established and he will need assisted reproduction: refer him now to a fertility centre for testicular sperm retrieval and ICSI

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。本病例没有记录精子存活率或活力，“死精”的诊断缺少依据；标本采于修复后 1.5 个月，还不到一个完整的生精周期，浓度也高于 WHO 2021 的第 5 百分位。在规范复查之前转诊辅助生殖为时过早（WHO 实验室手册第 6 版，2021）。
feedback.en: No. This case records no vitality or motility, so the necrospermia diagnosis has nothing to stand on; the sample came 1.5 months after the repair, short of a full cycle of sperm production, and the concentration is above the WHO 2021 5th centile. Referral for assisted reproduction before a proper repeat is premature (WHO laboratory manual, 6th edition, 2021).

text.zh-CN: 精子浓度高于 WHO 参考下限，勃起也正常，结果基本正常：让他放心，结束泌尿外科随访，有生育困难时再来
text.en: The concentration is above the WHO lower limit and his erections are normal, so the results are essentially normal: reassure him and end urology follow-up, to come back only if conceiving later proves hard

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。浓度高于第 5 百分位并不等于一份正常的精液分析：活力和存活率缺失，正常形态的数据存疑，而且标本采得太早。WHO 2021 的参考值是可育男性的第 5 百分位，不是诊断界值；应在 3 个月或更晚完整复查，同时复查激素（WHO 实验室手册第 6 版，2021）。
feedback.en: No. A concentration above the 5th centile is not a normal analysis: motility and vitality are missing, the normal-forms figure is doubtful and the sample was taken too early. WHO 2021 reference values are 5th centiles of fertile men, not diagnostic cut-offs; repeat a complete analysis at three months or later, with the hormones (WHO laboratory manual, 6th edition, 2021).

text.zh-CN: 催乳素和雌二醇升高提示垂体病变：先做垂体 MRI 并开始卡麦角林，等激素降到正常后再复查精液
text.en: Raised prolactin and oestradiol point to a pituitary problem: arrange a pituitary MRI and start cabergoline, and repeat the semen analysis once the hormones are normal

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。多发伤和多次手术之后，应激、疼痛和许多药物都可能让催乳素轻度升高，而他的睾酮、LH、FSH 都正常。美国内分泌学会（2011）要求先排除药物和其他继发原因，再考虑垂体影像或治疗；正确的做法是恢复后复查，而不是立即做 MRI、用卡麦角林。
feedback.en: No. After major trauma and several operations, stress, pain and many medicines can raise prolactin a little, and his testosterone, LH and FSH are normal. The Endocrine Society (2011) asks for medicines and other secondary causes to be excluded before pituitary imaging or treatment; repeat the tests after recovery rather than ordering an MRI and cabergoline now.

text.zh-CN: 问清今天的发现及其时间、车祸经过、伤情和受伤后做过的手术
text.en: Established what he found today and when, how the crash happened, his injuries and the operations since

text.zh-CN: 手术前询问伤前睾丸情况、子女与生育打算、目前用药和过敏史
text.en: Before planning an operation, asked about his testes before the injury, children and plans, current medicines and allergies

text.zh-CN: 先取得同意、有陪同者在场，再检查右侧阴囊、会阴和肛周，并从头到脚复查一遍
text.en: With consent and a chaperone first, examined the right hemiscrotum, the perineum and the perianal skin, and re-examined him head to toe

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把会阴部肿物当作移位的睾丸，并先做超声
text.en: At the first attempt, treated the perineal mass as a displaced testis and scanned before anything else

text.zh-CN: 调阅伤后影像和首次尿常规，并在会诊时申请、随后阅读阴囊及会阴超声
text.en: Reviewed the injury imaging and the first urinalysis, requested the scrotal and perineal ultrasound at the consultation and read it

text.zh-CN: 没有对会阴部肿物穿刺、切开或床旁挤压复位，也没有切除睾丸或做睾丸活检
text.en: Did not needle, incise or push back the perineal mass, remove a testis or biopsy the testes

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择尽早切开复位并固定两侧睾丸，并在没有推迟的情况下预约了手术
text.en: Chose prompt open reduction with fixation of both testes at the first attempt, and booked the operation without first deferring it

text.zh-CN: 术前与骨科和麻醉科协调，查阅术中所见并完成松解、复位与固定
text.en: Coordinated with orthopaedics and anaesthesia before the operation, read the operative findings and completed the release, reduction and fixation

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即区分睾丸存活与生精功能，并在看到术后结果之前和他谈了生育
text.en: Separated viability from sperm production at the first attempt, and talked to him about fertility before the post-operative results

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确解读术后 1.5 个月的精液和激素结果，并安排了规范复查
text.en: Read the 1.5-month semen and hormone results correctly at the first attempt and arranged a proper repeat

text.zh-CN: 没有凭早期结果转诊辅助生殖、做垂体 MRI 或使用卡麦角林
text.en: Did not refer for assisted reproduction, order a pituitary MRI or start cabergoline on the early results

text.zh-CN: 沟通：私密检查的同意，手术的解释与知情同意，诚实的生育咨询
text.en: Communication: consent for the intimate examination, explaining and consenting the operation, honest fertility counselling

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始接诊、采集信息、解释与计划、结束）：自我介绍，先问他自己发现了什么、最担心什么；检查阴囊和会阴之前说明原因、取得同意、拉好床帘并请护士陪同，检查中尊重隐私。读完超声后用通俗的话说明：车祸时下身受到挤压，一枚睾丸被挤出了阴囊，另一枚也移到了对侧；需要在他能耐受麻醉时尽早手术，把两枚分别放回自己一侧、缝合固定并修补中间的隔，与骨科和麻醉科一起定时间；知情同意讲清少见的情况——只有睾丸确认坏死时才会切除。如果他问为什么现在才发现，如实回答，不猜测之前有没有检查过（病例没有记录）。术后如实告诉他：两枚睾丸颜色正常、都保留了下来，这是好消息，但能否生育要看约 3 个月后的精液检查；看到术后 1.5 个月的结果时，解释报告上的“死精”为什么还不能算数、为什么要复查，既不虚假保证，也不过早下不育的结论。每一步用复述确认他听懂，并留出提问的时间。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering information, explaining and planning, closing): introduces themselves and first asks what he has noticed and what worries him most; before examining the scrotum and perineum explains why, obtains consent, draws the curtain and has a nurse chaperone, and respects his privacy throughout. Once the scan is read, explains in plain words that the crash squeezed his groin, pushing one testicle out of the scrotum and the other across to the opposite side, and that an operation as soon as he is fit for an anaesthetic will put each back on its own side, stitch both in place and repair the wall between them, timed with the bone and anaesthetic teams; the consent covers the uncommon case — a testicle is removed only if it proves to be dead. If he asks why this was found only now, answers honestly without guessing whether he was examined earlier (the case does not record it). After the operation tells him honestly that both testicles looked healthy and were kept — good news — but that fertility will be judged by a semen test about three months later; when the 1.5-month results come, explains why the report's 'dead sperm' label cannot yet be relied on and why the test is repeated, with neither false reassurance nor a premature verdict of infertility. Checks understanding by teach-back at each step and leaves room for questions.

name.en: Nurse Ning

knowledge.zh-CN: 病房交班（ISBAR）：30岁男性，车祸多发伤后第 13 天，在病房恢复中；今天解小便时自己发现右侧阴囊空虚，已请泌尿外科会诊。床旁有床帘可以拉上，私密部位检查时她可以陪同；超声仪需要从影像科推到病房床旁；病房护士站和手术室都有病历终端。复述医嘱并完成护理范围内的工作；只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断。被问到今天的生命体征、用药或过敏时，如实说没有可以报告的记录，绝不报出数字。
knowledge.en: Ward handover (ISBAR): a 30-year-old man on day 13 after multiple injuries in a road crash, recovering on the ward; today, passing urine, he noticed the right side of his scrotum was empty, and urology has been asked to see him. The bed has a curtain and she will chaperone the intimate examination; the ultrasound machine has to be brought from imaging to the ward bed; there are records terminals at the ward nurses' station and in theatre. Reads orders back and carries out nursing-scope tasks; reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses. Asked for today's observations, medicines or allergies, says plainly there is nothing recorded to report — never gives a number.

name.zh-CN: 岑医生（泌尿外科上级医师）
name.en: Dr Cen (urology attending)

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“空虚的阴囊加上会阴部这个肿物，你最先想到什么？”“在任何针碰它之前，你需要知道什么？”“你怎么知道哪一枚是哪一侧的？”“把它推进最近的那一侧会怎样？”“为什么要尽早，而不是等两周？”“颜色正常说明了什么，没说明什么？”“修复后 1.5 个月的精液能说明什么？”可以讲解 ATLS（第 11 版，2025）二次评估中检查会阴的原则、EAU 泌尿系创伤指南（2026）关于脱位睾丸复位并固定的原则、AUA 泌尿系创伤指南（2020）关于阴囊钝性伤超声和探查的原则、WHO 实验室手册（第 6 版，2021）的精液参考值和美国内分泌学会（2011）关于催乳素升高的原则；学员读到相应记录之后，可以指出记录的经过（伤后第 13 天才由他本人发现、伤后第 25 天才手术、术后 1.5 个月就查精液）与现行做法的差别。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例中没有的资料（生命体征、入院时是否查过会阴、超声血流、手术延迟的原因、精子活力和存活率、激素参考范围、远期结局都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. “An empty hemiscrotum and this perineal lump — what comes to mind first?”, “Before any needle goes near it, what do you need to know?”, “How do you know which testis is which?”, “What happens if you push it into the nearest side?”, “Why early rather than in two weeks?”, “What does normal colour tell you, and what not?”, “What can a semen sample 1.5 months after the repair tell you?”. May explain the principles of ATLS (11th edition, 2025) on examining the perineum in the secondary survey, the EAU Guidelines on Urological Trauma (2026) on reduction with fixation of a dislocated testis, the AUA Urotrauma Guideline (2020) on ultrasound and exploration in blunt scrotal injury, the WHO laboratory manual (6th edition, 2021) on semen reference values and the Endocrine Society (2011) on raised prolactin; once the learner has read the records, may contrast the recorded course (found by the patient himself on day 13, operated on day 25, semen tested 1.5 months after the operation) with current practice. Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds no data the case lacks (vital signs, whether the perineum was examined on admission, ultrasound blood flow, the reason for the delay, sperm motility and vitality, hormone reference ranges and the long-term outcome are not recorded).

name.en: Dr Fan (radiologist)

knowledge.zh-CN: 放射科医生，只解读学员已经读过的影像报告（伤后影像、腹部超声、阴囊及会阴超声）：说明沿精索追踪为什么能确定睾丸属于哪一侧，彩色多普勒能补充什么（血流、扭转），超声上怎样识别白膜破裂；也说明本病例的报告里有什么、没有什么。不报告学员尚未读到的结果；不编造血流、白膜或阴囊中隔的超声所见（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Radiologist who interprets only the imaging reports the learner has read (the injury imaging, the abdominal ultrasound, the scrotal and perineal ultrasound): why tracing each spermatic cord tells you which side a testis belongs to, what colour Doppler would add (perfusion, torsion), how a tear of the tunica shows on ultrasound — and what this case's reports do and do not contain. Never reports a result the learner has not read, and never invents blood flow, tunical or septal findings (none is recorded).

name.en: Dr Qi (orthopaedic surgeon)

knowledge.zh-CN: 骨科医生，主管他的骨折，可以介绍记录中的手术经过：休克纠正后伤后当天右小腿截肢，第 8 天右前臂和右股骨近端骨折固定。与学员讨论他能否耐受麻醉、术中体位，以及阴囊手术与骨科治疗的时间协调。读到伤后影像之后，可以解读骨盆和髋臼骨折。不提供病例中没有的资料（骨折分型、固定方式、截肢平面、目前用药和抗凝、今天的生命体征都没有记录），也不评论睾丸的处理。
knowledge.en: Orthopaedic surgeon in charge of his fractures, who can summarise the recorded operations: the right lower-leg amputation on the day of injury once the shock was corrected, and fixation of the right forearm and proximal femoral fractures on day 8. Discusses with the learner his fitness for anaesthesia, his positioning, and how a scrotal operation fits around his orthopaedic care; once the learner has read the injury imaging, can interpret the pelvic and acetabular fractures. Adds nothing the case does not record (fracture classification, fixation method, amputation level, current medicines and anticoagulation, today's observations) and does not comment on the management of the testes.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：多发伤后的阴囊空虚——识别睾丸交叉脱位、把握复位时机与评估生育
title.en: Debrief: an empty hemiscrotum after polytrauma — recognising crossed testicular dislocation, timing the repair and judging fertility

conclusion.zh-CN: 30岁男性，卡车前排两腿叉开睡着、未系安全带，撞车时被夹在座位与仪表台之间：创伤性休克，右前臂、骨盆、右股骨和右胫腓骨骨折，右足严重毁损，伤后当天右小腿截肢，第 8 天右前臂及右股骨近端骨折固定。伤后第 13 天，他小便时发现右侧阴囊空虚；肛门右前外侧皮肤青紫，其下有光滑、有压痛、睾丸大小的肿块。超声沿精索追踪：右侧睾丸在左侧阴囊，左侧睾丸在肛门右前方软组织（约 3.5 cm × 1.7 cm，距皮肤约 0.34 cm）。伤后第 25 天探查见阴囊中隔破裂和纤维索带，两侧睾丸、附睾形态颜色正常，松解后两侧复位固定并修补中隔。术后 1.5 个月勃起正常，精液量 3.2 mL、浓度 17.5 × 10⁶/mL、正常形态 85%，报告诊断“外伤后死精”（没有活力和存活率记录）；孕酮、催乳素、雌二醇高于参考范围，睾酮、LH、FSH 正常。诊断：创伤性睾丸交叉脱位。按现行做法：二次评估中检查会阴；先做超声（含多普勒）再处理肿物；在他能耐受麻醉时尽早切开复位、两侧固定并修补中隔，而不是等待 12 天；修复后约 3 个月或更晚按 WHO 2021 标准复查精液，激素在恢复后复查。远期结局没有记录。
conclusion.en: A 30-year-old man, asleep and unbelted with his legs apart in the front of a truck, was crushed between the seat and the dashboard: traumatic shock, pelvic and right-limb fractures, a right lower-leg amputation that day. On day 13 he found his right hemiscrotum empty; a smooth, tender, testis-sized mass lay under bruised perineal skin. Tracing the cords, ultrasound put the right testis in the left hemiscrotum and the left testis anterior-right of the anus (about 3.5 × 1.7 cm, 0.34 cm deep). On day 25 exploration found a torn septum and fibrous bands, both testes normal in shape and colour; both were reduced and fixed and the septum repaired. At 1.5 months: normal erections; semen 3.2 mL, 17.5 × 10⁶/mL, 85 % normal forms, labelled post-traumatic necrospermia, no vitality recorded. Diagnosis: traumatic crossed testicular dislocation. Today: scan before touching the mass, reduce and fix both testes once he is fit, judge fertility at three months or later (WHO 2021).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 车祸时两腿叉开、会阴被挤在座位与仪表台之间，十几天后出现空虚的半侧阴囊和会阴部光滑、有压痛、睾丸大小的肿物：首先要想到睾丸被挤出了阴囊。
keyReasoning.en: A crush with the legs apart against the dashboard, then an empty hemiscrotum and a smooth, tender, testis-sized perineal mass: the first thought is a testis forced out of the scrotum.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 这个肿物在被确认之前，不能穿刺、切开或挤压；超声能找到两枚睾丸，并显示它们是否完整。
keyReasoning.en: Until it is identified, the mass must not be needled, cut or pushed; ultrasound finds both testes and shows whether they are intact.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 睾丸属于哪一侧要看精索，不看位置：会阴右侧那枚是左侧睾丸，左侧阴囊里那枚是右侧睾丸——这是越过中线的交叉脱位。
keyReasoning.en: Side is read from the cord, not from the position: the testis in the right perineum is the left one and the testis in the left hemiscrotum is the right one — a dislocation that has crossed the midline.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 所以修复只能在手术中完成：每枚睾丸回到自己一侧、两侧固定、修补中隔；把会阴部那枚推进最近的右侧阴囊，会把它放错边。
keyReasoning.en: So the repair is operative: each testis back to its own side, both fixed, the septum repaired; pushing the perineal testis into the nearest, right, hemiscrotum would put it on the wrong side.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 术中颜色正常说明睾丸存活，不说明生精正常；修复后 1.5 个月的精液落在一个生精周期之内，不能作为生育的最终结论。
keyReasoning.en: Normal colour at operation shows the testes are alive, not that they make sperm normally; a semen sample 1.5 months after the repair falls within one cycle of sperm production and is no final verdict on fertility.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告，本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能说明延迟 12 天手术对睾丸或生育造成了多少影响，也不能证明更早手术会改变结局。病例没有记录生命体征、入院时的会阴查体、超声血流、手术延迟的原因、精子活力与存活率、激素参考范围和远期结局；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show what the 12-day delay cost the testes or his fertility, or that earlier surgery would have changed the result. No vital signs, admission perineal examination, ultrasound blood flow, reason for the delay, sperm motility or vitality, hormone reference ranges or long-term outcome are recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 会诊时和入院时的生命体征与全身情况，以及休克是怎样处理的。
unknowns.en: Vital signs and general condition at the consultation and on admission, and how the shock was managed.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院时的初次和二次评估是否检查过阴囊和会阴，阴囊或会阴的青紫、肿胀从什么时候开始。
unknowns.en: Whether the scrotum and perineum were examined in the admission primary and secondary survey, and when the scrotal or perineal bruising or swelling began.

unknowns.zh-CN: 伤前两侧睾丸的位置（隐睾、疝气、腹股沟或阴囊手术史）、生育情况、子女与生育打算，以及基础性激素水平。
unknowns.en: His testes before the injury (undescended testis, hernia, groin or scrotal surgery), his fertility, children and plans, and his baseline sex hormones.

unknowns.zh-CN: 超声的彩色多普勒血流、右侧睾丸的大小、白膜和阴囊中隔的超声表现，以及是否尝试过手法复位。
unknowns.en: Colour Doppler blood flow, the size of the right testis, the tunica and the septum on ultrasound, and whether a manual reduction was tried.

unknowns.zh-CN: 为什么手术安排在伤后第 25 天；麻醉方式、固定方法、切开白膜后是否出血，以及术后并发症。
unknowns.en: Why the operation took place on day 25; the anaesthetic, the fixation technique, whether the testes bled when incised, and any complications.

unknowns.zh-CN: 目前用药（镇痛、抗凝）、过敏史、既往病史、吸烟和饮酒情况。
unknowns.en: His current medicines (analgesia, anticoagulation), allergies, past history, smoking and alcohol.

unknowns.zh-CN: 精子活力、存活率、精子总数、形态学的评判方法和实验室参考值；睾酮、LH、FSH 的数值，各项激素的参考范围和采血时间。
unknowns.en: Sperm motility, vitality and total number, the morphology method and the laboratory's reference values; the testosterone, LH and FSH values, the hormone reference ranges and the sampling time.

unknowns.zh-CN: 远期结局：睾丸大小、此后的精液和激素复查、生育情况，以及有无再次脱位。
unknowns.en: The long-term outcome: testicular size, later semen and hormone tests, fertility and any recurrence.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 会阴和外生殖器属于二次评估的内容（ATLS 第 11 版，2025），骨盆或会阴挤压伤后，在病情稳定时还要从头到脚再查一遍（三次评估）。记录与现行做法：本例的阴囊空虚是伤后第 13 天由他本人在小便时发现的，入院时是否检查过会阴没有记录。会阴受压的车祸伤后出现空虚的半侧阴囊，应按睾丸脱位处理，直到排除为止。
teachingPoints.en: The perineum and genitalia belong to the secondary survey (ATLS, 11th edition, 2025), and after a pelvic or perineal crush a head-to-toe re-examination once he is stable (the tertiary survey) looks again. Then and now: here the empty hemiscrotum was found on day 13 by the patient himself while passing urine, and whether the perineum was examined on admission is not recorded. After a crush with the legs apart, an empty hemiscrotum is a dislocation until proven otherwise.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 先影像，后动手：AUA 泌尿系创伤指南（2020）支持对怀疑睾丸破裂的阴囊钝性伤做超声，EAU 泌尿系创伤指南（2026）在睾丸创伤中专门讨论睾丸脱位。超声加彩色多普勒可以定位睾丸、显示血流、发现破裂或扭转；本例的超声沿精索确定了两枚睾丸的侧别，但没有血流记录——今天应当要求做多普勒。
teachingPoints.en: Image before you act: the AUA Urotrauma Guideline (2020) supports ultrasound for blunt scrotal injury with suspected rupture, and the EAU Guidelines on Urological Trauma (2026) deal with testicular dislocation within testicular trauma. Ultrasound with colour Doppler locates the testes, shows their perfusion and picks up rupture or torsion; this scan assigned each testis by its cord but records no blood flow — today, ask for Doppler.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 复位之后要固定（EAU 泌尿系创伤指南 2026）。越过中线的交叉脱位无法在床旁复位：要切开探查、松解，把每枚睾丸放回自己一侧，两侧固定并修补中隔，并在他能安全麻醉时尽早进行，与骨科、麻醉科协调。记录与现行做法：本例在伤后第 25 天、会诊后 12 天手术，术中已有纤维索带；这是历史经过，不是可以照搬的等待期，延迟的原因没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Reduction is followed by fixation (EAU Guidelines on Urological Trauma 2026). A crossed dislocation cannot be reduced at the bedside: explore, release, return each testis to its own side, fix both and repair the septum, as soon as he can safely have an anaesthetic, with the orthopaedic and anaesthetic teams. Then and now: here the operation came on day 25, 12 days after the consultation, when fibrous bands had already formed — history, not an interval to copy; the reason for the delay is not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 存活在术中判断：颜色正常（切开白膜后有出血）的睾丸应保留并固定；探查后修复、只把无法挽救的睾丸切除，正是 AUA 泌尿系创伤指南（2020）处理睾丸破裂的思路。但存活不等于生精正常：移位、受压、局部温度升高、创伤和全身疾病都可能影响生精。要如实告诉患者，并安排修复后约 3 个月或更晚的精液分析和睾丸大小随访。
teachingPoints.en: Viability is judged at operation: a testis normal in colour (and bleeding when the tunica is incised) is kept and fixed; explore and repair, keeping orchidectomy for a testis that cannot be saved, is the logic of the AUA Urotrauma Guideline (2020) for testicular rupture. But alive is not the same as making sperm normally: displacement, pressure, warmth, the injury and his illness can all impair it. Tell him so honestly, and plan a semen analysis about three months or more after the repair, with testicular size at follow-up.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 按 WHO 实验室手册（第 6 版，2021）读精液分析：可育男性的第 5 百分位为精液量 1.4 mL、精子浓度 16 × 10⁶/mL、精子总数 39 × 10⁶、总活力 42%、前向运动 30%、正常形态 4%，这些是参照点而不是诊断界值，单次分析也不足以判断不育。死精子症要靠存活率检测才能成立；一个生精周期约 3 个月，修复后 1.5 个月的标本反映的仍是受伤和手术期间的状态。记录与现行做法：报告在术后 1.5 个月诊断“外伤后死精”，本病例没有活力和存活率的记录，正常形态 85%（按严格标准极不寻常）的评判方法也没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Read semen analysis against the WHO laboratory manual (6th edition, 2021): the 5th centiles in fertile men are volume 1.4 mL, concentration 16 × 10⁶/mL, total number 39 × 10⁶, total motility 42 %, progressive motility 30 % and normal forms 4 % — reference points, not diagnostic cut-offs, and one analysis does not establish infertility. Necrozoospermia needs a vitality test, and a cycle of sperm production takes about three months, so a sample 1.5 months after the repair still reflects the injury and the operations. Then and now: the report called it post-traumatic necrospermia at 1.5 months, this case records no motility or vitality, and the method behind 85 % normal forms — exceptional under strict criteria — is not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 激素要结合背景解读：多发伤和多次手术之后，催乳素、雌二醇和孕酮的轻度变化很难单独解释，应激、疼痛和许多药物都可能让催乳素升高。美国内分泌学会（2011）要求先排除药物和其他继发原因，再考虑垂体影像或治疗；他的睾酮、LH、FSH 都正常，下一步是恢复后复查，而不是垂体 MRI 和卡麦角林。
teachingPoints.en: Read hormones in context: after major trauma and several operations, small changes in prolactin, oestradiol and progesterone are hard to interpret on their own, and stress, pain and many medicines can raise prolactin. The Endocrine Society (2011) asks for medicines and other secondary causes to be excluded before pituitary imaging or treatment; with normal testosterone, LH and FSH, his next step is a repeat after recovery, not a pituitary MRI and cabergoline.
